notes.title: Update - 03.26.2024
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where player statistics were not recorded when exiting the game
 Now, when completing a level, one star is awarded, even if you score 0 pts

notes.title: Hotfix - 08.29.2021
notes.content:
• Fixed a bug where at the "The Hunt" level in some cases the enemies stopped spawning after skipping dialogs

• Fixed a bug where the turret tower did not turn red when getting damage

• Added a new animation of the death of the final boss

• Fixed typos in some dialogs

notes.title: Update - 08.25.2021
notes.content:
• Developed and implemented a new concept of the Wall - boss from the "Assault" level. Added various new behaviors using the Bullethell mechanic

https://psv4.userapi.com/c856432/u277514009/docs/d9/d8f8e2b361b8/Project_1_1.gif

• Changed the behavior of the Turret. Now the Turret tower does not rotate randomly, but gradually rotates from top to bottom.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40885502/ab477abc33a4d1e23f0d9962f81d200d433dfe22.gif

• The reload time of the Heavy Fighter's guns has been increased.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40885502/d016e4ad9c2f0e9340d08d549c48166e09fd1c9b.gif

• Added the ability to skip in-game dialogues. A skip prompt appears in the upper right corner of the screen.

• Added the ability to use the bonus by clicking on RMB.

• Other minor fixes and improvements

notes.title: Hotfix - 08.21.2021
notes.content:
• Fixed a bug in which in some cases in the battle with the final boss did not appear the dialog box
• Fixed the final dialogue at the "Assault" level
• Fixed names of characters in some dialogues
